Generated Narrative: StructureDefinition EHDSDocumentSearchMetadata

NameFlagsCard.TypeDescription & Constraints
EHDSDocumentSearchMetadata 0..*EHDSSearchMetadataDocument search metadata model

Elements defined in Ancestors:subject, identifier, clinicalEventTime[x], version, author[x], date, attestation, status, language, lastUpdate
EHDSDocumentSearchMetadata.identifier 1..*IdentifierUnique identifier of the document.
EHDSDocumentSearchMetadata.clinicalEventTime[x] 0..0Time or period the clinical content applies to (e.g. specimen collection time, onset of a condition, period a medication was taken).
EHDSDocumentSearchMetadata.version 1..1stringVersion of the document.
EHDSDocumentSearchMetadata.author[x] 1..*EHDSHealthProfessional, EHDSOrganisation, EHDSDeviceInformation describing who authored the resource or document.
EHDSDocumentSearchMetadata.date 1..1dateTimeDate of finalisation/issuance of the document.
EHDSDocumentSearchMetadata.attestation 0..*BaseDocument attestation details.
EHDSDocumentSearchMetadata.attestation.attester[x] 1..1EHDSHealthProfessional, EHDSDeviceAttester who validated the document.
EHDSDocumentSearchMetadata.attestation.dateTime 1..1dateTimeDate and time of the approval of the document by the attester.
EHDSDocumentSearchMetadata.status 1..1CodeableConceptStatus of the document.
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: HL7 Composition Status
EHDSDocumentSearchMetadata.language 0..*CodeableConceptLanguage in which the document is written. Language is expressed by the IETF language tag.
EHDSDocumentSearchMetadata.lastUpdate 0..1dateTimeDate and time of the last system-level update to this document (system update instant). This is technical metadata and does not represent a clinical event time.
EHDSDocumentSearchMetadata.documentCategory 1..1CodeableConceptBroad category of document (e.g. 11502-2 Laboratory report).
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: LOINC
EHDSDocumentSearchMetadata.documentType 1..1CodeableConceptType of document (e.g. 18725-2 Microbiology studies (set)).
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: LOINC
EHDSDocumentSearchMetadata.documentTitle 1..1stringHuman-readable document title that may be displayed in search results etc. This may be documentType’s display name, or it may be assembled from multiple elements. Examples: ‘Laboratory result report’, ‘Patient summary of Jane Green 10.12.2024’.
EHDSDocumentSearchMetadata.period 0..1PeriodTime of service that is being documented.
EHDSDocumentSearchMetadata.legalAuthentication 0..*BaseDocument legal authentication details. Legal authentication metadata is included only where required by applicable legal or organisational frameworks. Absence of legal authentication does not affect interoperability compliance under this profile.
EHDSDocumentSearchMetadata.legalAuthentication.legalAuthenticator[x] 1..1The person taking responsibility for the medical content of the document. legalAuthenticator may be different from author and attester (e.g author=junior doctor, attester=senior physician, legalAuthenticator= attending physician).
EHDSDocumentSearchMetadata.legalAuthentication.legalAuthenticator[x].legalAuthenticatorEHDSHealthProfessionalEHDSHealthProfessional
EHDSDocumentSearchMetadata.legalAuthentication.legalAuthenticator[x].legalAuthenticatorEHDSOrganisationEHDSOrganisation
EHDSDocumentSearchMetadata.legalAuthentication.dateTime 1..1dateTimeDate and time when the document was authorised.
EHDSDocumentSearchMetadata.eventCategory 0..*CodeableConceptCategorisation of the event covered by the document (e.g. laboratory study types, imaging study types including modality). Selection of such tags or labels depends on the use case and agreement between data-sharing parties. This metadata element serves primarily for searching and filtering purposes.
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: SNOMED GPS, LOINC, DICOM CID 33 Modality
EHDSDocumentSearchMetadata.serviceSpecialty 0..*CodeableConceptAdditional details about where the content was created (e.g. clinical speciality).
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: SNOMED GPS
EHDSDocumentSearchMetadata.custodian 0..1EHDSOrganisationOrganisation that is in charge of maintaining the document.

name: EHDSDocumentSearchMetadata
title: Document search metadata model
description: Metadata for searching documents, based on WP v5 Annex III and the final review instructions. This search-metadata model is separate from EHDSDocument and its resource-content hierarchy.
purpose: Document search metadata specialises the independent search-metadata model. It does not include the document's content, presentedForm or countryOfOrigin. Date is mandatory in both this model and EHDSDocument.
